findings.finding: The Q3 revenue guide of about $66m is a floor. On the 2026-07-30 call management said it covers only orders that already hold a China export permit or need none, so any further permits are 'upside, even significant upside'. Consensus ($66.0-66.1m, EPS $0.30-0.31) sits on that floor and the whisper is $0.33. A beat on the reported quarter is the likelier outcome, but it lands inside what the company told the market to expect.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Earnings-only history rebuilt from the 8-K 2.02 dates: Q2 2026 (2026-07-30) beat ($47.6m vs $34.1m) with a raised guide, +28.7%; Q1 2026 (2026-04-30) +21.2%; Q4 2025 (2026-02-19) +24.7%; Q3 2025 (2025-10-30) +8.6%; Q2 2025 (2025-07-31) -7.7%. The earlier miss came from permits (Q4 2025 short of guidance on fewer MOFCOM permits). Beats have been bought, but every big one came with a large guide step-up.
findings.why_not_priced: The sell side has parked consensus exactly on the guide ($66.0-66.1m) rather than above it, although management called the guide permit-exclusive. If the market priced the permit upside, consensus would sit above $66m and the whisper would be well above $0.33. The skew does lean that way (calls bid), so part of this is priced.
findings.independence: The whisper EPS of $0.33 vs $0.30 consensus (https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/axti) points the same way. Yunnan Germanium's Q3 (finding 2) shows InP volume and price rising at a peer. The same call transcript also underlies the Q4-capacity finding.

findings.finding: Yunnan Germanium, a China-listed InP substrate competitor, reported Q3 2026 on 2026-10-20, after AXT last spoke. Single-quarter revenue was about RMB 632m (+134.6% YoY), and it swung to a RMB 102m profit from a loss. It attributed the growth to higher volume AND higher average selling prices of InP and other compound semiconductor materials. Contract liabilities rose to RMB 198m on InP prepayments. This supports AXT's InP pricing and a gross margin at or above the 45% that management told analysts to model (target 'begins with a 5').
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 gross margin went from 29.6% to 44.9% alongside a +28.7% reaction. Margin surprises have coincided with AXT's largest up-moves, though revenue and guidance moved at the same time.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a Chinese A-share filing covered only in Chinese-language press, and no English AXT note in the search links it to AXT. AXTI fell to $52 by 2026-10-22, two days after the peer print, which does not look like a market reading InP pricing strength into AXT. This is a proxy: AXT's own revenue is capped by capacity and permits, not by demand, so the transmission runs through price and margin only.
findings.independence: This is a different company and a different document. Lumentum (2026-08-11) said its InP fab is fully allocated (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/lumentum-q4-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-11/), which is the same demand signal from a customer.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-27/28 (8-K Items 1.01/7.01) subsidiary Tongmei signed to raise RMB 1.91-3.67bn (US$285-545m) from institutional investors, led by a fund of a major Asian asset manager and including an affiliate of an existing customer. AXT recapitalises Tongmei with $400m and keeps about 73.4%. The money is for InP capacity expansion and raw-material capacity; closing is expected December 2026. What the money buys is a capacity ramp that backlog (>$100m) and the Lumentum/Coherent/Casela long-term supply agreements already corroborate. The cost is redemption rights at subscription price plus 8% a year if there is no qualified IPO (13% IRR hurdle) within three years, which AXT can settle in its own stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The December 2025 AXT public offering sent shares about -15% premarket (https://www.itiger.com/news/2595878775). The April 2026 $632.5m offering came around the Q1 print, and the stock closed at an all-time high that week. This raise is at subsidiary level and non-dilutive to AXT holders except through the redemption-in-stock option.
findings.why_not_priced: It was public one session before the print and the stock is +19% over 5 days, so much of it is already in the price. What is not yet priced is any capacity target or 2027 revenue path that the call attaches to this money; until then the market cannot size the ramp it funds.
findings.independence: The press release in the same filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1051627/000121390026113058/ea030977401ex99-1.htm) is the same document family. Backlog >$100m and the long-term supply agreements come from the Q2 call (a different document) and corroborate the use of the money.

findings.finding: The Q4 bar may be at the capacity ceiling. Q4 consensus is $77.45m (+17% on the $66m Q3 guide), while management said exit-2026 InP capacity is about $60m a quarter and that it 'cannot predict the future timing of permits'. A Q4 guide set again at permit-secured revenue only could land below $77m. That is a risk on the line this stock trades on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q4 2025 guide-miss came from permits (Jan 2026 preannouncement, -11.0% on 2026-01-09 in the baseline). Guide step-ups bought +21% to +29% in Feb, Apr and Jul 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus has risen to $77.45m for Q4 and 2027 revenue estimates doubled to about $461m between June and September, so the street has not marked Q4 to a permit-only guide. The 20-day -24.7% drawdown may already carry some of this; it was blamed on a sector-wide optics selloff with no company news. Sized small: 18% of shares are short and calls are bid, so a disappointment meets a squeeze mechanism.
findings.independence: The capacity figure comes from the Q2 call transcript (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/07/30/axt-axti-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/), a different document from the consensus source. Nothing else independently points to a Q4 guide below consensus.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: short interest rose 11% to 11.98m shares (18.3% of shares outstanding) at the 2026-10-15 settlement. Sealed 25-delta skew is -14.6 vol points (calls bid). The stock fell about 25% over 20 days on an optics-sector selloff with no company news, then rebounded +19% in 5 days. Shorts are building and the options market is paying for upside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last three earnings prints ran +21% to +29% with a sizeable short base already in place. Days to cover has stayed near 1-1.4 all year, so a squeeze clears quickly.
findings.why_not_priced: Skew already prices upside, so this is mostly priced. What remains is the mechanism: a rising short into a print where the guide is a stated floor gives asymmetric covering risk. Days to cover is only 1.4, which caps it.
findings.independence: The sealed baseline's skew (-14.57) and P/C OI 0.74 come from a separate data source. The Oct 8 sector-selloff attribution with no company news is at https://www.tikr.com/de/blog/axt-stock-fell-10-in-a-day-even-as-analysts-more-than-doubled-their-2027-revenue-estimates-heres-where-the-stock-could-go.

findings.finding: Lumentum's long-term supply and capacity reservation agreement (July 2026, through 2031) obliges a first $43.5m deposit within 30 business days of contract start. That lands in the Q3 balance sheet beside Coherent's $25.4m and Casela's $22.3m prepayments. Customer advances were already $12.1m at June 30 against $0.1m at year-end. Q3 should show a visible jump in customer advances and operating cash flow.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on cash flow or customer deposits; the stock trades on revenue, gross margin and guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The deposits were disclosed, but consensus free cash flow for 2026 is still about -$33m (TIKR, 2026-10-09). A Q3 operating cash inflow from deposits would read better than that. It is a balance-sheet item, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1051627/000143774926027677/axti20260630_10q.htm) shows advances from customers rising to $12,078k from $103k. The Coherent/Casela prepayment figures come from the Q2 call coverage (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/axt-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-07-30/).

outside_window.finding: China's one-year suspension of expanded export controls under the late-2025 US-China truce runs to about 2026-11-10 (the US-specific gallium/germanium/antimony suspension to 2026-11-27); in August 2026 extension talks were reported as underway. A lapse or renewal would move InP permit expectations, but it is dated after the exit window. Call commentary on it inside the window is covered by the guidance finding.
Tongmei financing closing (minimum RMB 1.91bn must close by 2026-12-20 or the subscription agreement terminates, subject to PRC government filings).
Coherent and Lumentum fiscal Q1 prints (typically early November) would update InP transceiver demand after AXT reports.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the skew (calls bid, -14.6) and with a rising short base, but cuts against the +19% 5-day run-up, which has already taken back part of the 20-day drawdown into a print whose consensus sits on the guide. That run-up is why p_up stays at 56 rather than 60+.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (inside the guide): the Q3 floor-beat finding cut from +1.0 to +0.6, and print_vs_bar from +4% to +3%, because consensus sits on a company guide the market was told to expect.
Lesson 7 (crowded short, skew): the one negative (Q4 guide vs capacity) shrunk from -1.0 to -0.6 for 18.3% of shares short and bid calls.
Lesson 5/9 (proxy, net of the rest): the Yunnan Germanium peer finding cut from +0.8 to +0.5, because AXT is constrained by capacity and permits, not demand.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the Tongmei raise kept positive, since the money funds capacity that backlog and long-term supply agreements corroborate. Trimmed from +0.5 to +0.4 because it was public the day before, after a +19% 5-day run.

Untrustworthy-history rule: the base rate was rebuilt from confirmed releases (median abs about 21%), so abs_move rose from 15 to 17 and p_up from 55 to 56 on the record of beats and raises being bought.
